notes.title: OpenGL and D3D12 versions
notes.notes: New D3D12 renderer with improved lighting, MSAA on sprites, improved font rendering and the HUD can now have the bloom effect.

notes.title: D3D12 Version
notes.notes: New D3D12 renderer with improved lighting, MSAA on sprites, improved font rendering and the HUD can now have the bloom effect.

notes.title: The enemies respawn after the "game over" screen
notes.notes: The enemies respawn after the "game over" screen. Keep in mind that the rest of the game state remains and it only resets after closing and starting a new round.
